question: Question
submit_confirm_body: Are you sure you want to submit? You cannot make further changes after this.
warning_focus_lost: You left the exam window. This has been recorded.
warning_final: Final warning: one more violation will auto-submit your exam.
auto_submit_notice: Your exam has been submitted automatically.
cannot_return_question: You cannot return to this question
consent_statement: I have read the instructions, I am sitting this examination alone, and I consent to being monitored for the duration of this exam.
exam_not_assigned: This examination is not assigned to you.
paper_unique: Your paper is generated for you alone — no two candidates get the same questions in the same order.
answers_autosave: Your answers save as you work, so a refresh or a dropped connection will not lose them.
marking_process: Objective questions are marked immediately. Written answers are reviewed by an examiner before your result is released.
system_check_hint: Every check below must pass before the exam can start.
browser_required: A modern Chrome, Edge or Firefox is required for proctoring to work.
camera_needs_face: Proctoring needs to see your face for the whole sitting.
microphone_required: Your microphone must be enabled before you can start.
internet_speed_detail: Needs at least {minMbps} Mbps so autosave and snapshots keep up.
fullscreen_detail: The exam runs in fullscreen for its whole duration.
display_detail: Only one monitor may be connected during the exam.
browser_not_supported: This browser is missing features this exam needs. Switch to a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
no_face_detected: No face detected. Make sure you're visible and well lit, then re-run.
multiple_faces_detected: {faceCount} people detected. Only you may be in frame.
camera_access_denied: No camera access. Allow camera permission in your browser, then re-run.
microphone_not_active: Microphone did not report as active.
microphone_access_denied: No microphone access. Allow microphone permission in your browser, then re-run.
speed_too_low: Only {mbps} Mbps measured — needs at least {minMbps} Mbps.
server_unreachable: Could not reach the exam server. Check your connection and re-run.
fullscreen_not_enabled: Not in fullscreen yet. Click Enable fullscreen.
fullscreen_blocked: Fullscreen was blocked by the browser. Allow it and try again.
display_browser_unsupported: This browser can't verify display count. Please confirm only one monitor is connected.
display_multiple: {count} displays detected. Disconnect the extra monitor(s) and re-check.
display_permission_denied: Display permission was blocked. Allow it and try again.
must_pass_to_continue: must pass before you can continue.
instructions_hint: The clock starts the moment you begin, and it does not pause.
move_between_questions: Move freely between questions using the palette.
answers_auto_save: Answers save automatically as you type or select.
blank_no_negative: Blank answers score zero and never attract a negative mark.
submit_final: Submitting is final — you cannot reopen the paper.
stay_in_frame: Stay in frame, alone, with your face visible.
leaving_recorded: Leaving the exam tab is recorded and warned about.
fullscreen_copy_paste: Exiting fullscreen and copy/paste attempts are recorded.
snapshots_stored: Webcam snapshots are stored for examiner review.
high_suspicion: A high suspicion score can end your session automatically.
one_attempt_detail: Once you start, this counts as your attempt even if you close the browser. If your time expires the paper is submitted for you.
monitoring_consent: I have read the instructions, I am sitting this examination alone, and I consent to webcam and browser-activity monitoring for its duration.
my_examinations_body: Assigned assessments across Academic courses and Corporate hiring assessments. Open an exam to view details and launch the proctored runner.
no_exams_assigned: When an examiner assigns you to a paper it will appear here.
no_exams_filtered: No exams match the selected filter category.
no_open_exams: None of your assigned exams are inside their active window at this time.
face_check_failed: The camera works, but the face check could not run. Reload the page and re-run the checks; if it keeps failing, contact your examiner.
